claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.27 EduTool.dev Sociology audit exposed a real mismatch: browser finalizer quality was 87/B while the downloaded ZIP regraded at 99/A because source proof was omitted.
Source-backed exports recover source-ledger rows from deterministic Course Map supporting-resource and reading cells when the live CourseGraph handoff is sparse.
The source normalizer extracts embedded URLs, DOI values, provider hints, and Creative Commons/open-access license labels from rendered resource text instead of dropping those receipts.
Package export merges CourseIR/CourseGraph rows with Course Map fallback rows before writing SOURCE_REPORT.md, sourceLedger, and sourceLedgerSummary.
The deep grader arms source-ledger checks from pipeline evidence as well as exported proof, so source-backed packages with no receipts receive a P1 honesty finding.
